title: Remove the migration retirement lists and old-format checks
outcome: Migration export/import handles only the current format, and no code, test or doc exists just to convert or refuse older formats.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md keep the export/import rule without the retirement lists and stay identical, and full-store-migration.md and shipped.md no longer describe retired data
Project notes store-recreated-182c123 and ssd-heavy-run-coordination are forgotten
The new build passes readiness and doctor on a copy of each live store

The old listing-cursor tests (LegacyListingCursor in catalog.rs and the legacy hex token test in the verbs response-budget tests) and the tests that only pin removed agent-grant flags and tables are removed (the removed authority_grant host-frame test already went with 950a6f1); generic unknown-field refusal tests remain (host_control_frames_reject_unknown_nested_fields, and import refusing unknown tables and columns by name); readers and tests for seals and policies recorded before acceptance evaluation stay, because both live stores still hold such records
The rename and retirement tests are gone from storage/migration/tests.rs, and the remaining export/import round-trip tests pass
The restored-history shape check in storage/work/schema.rs is removed

storage/migration.rs keeps plain export/import but has no renamed-column, retired-column or retired-table lists and none of the one-time conversions (the direct-binding table mapping, the stored-field rewrite, the lease omission), and import refuses any table or column the current format lacks, by name

completion.summary: Migration export/import now handles only the current format. The rename/retirement lists, the direct-binding table mapping, the stored-field rewrite, the lease omission, the restored-history shape check and its read-time twin, and the tests that only pinned removed cursors, grant flags and tables are gone. Import refuses by name an unknown table or column (format marker included), a missing required column, rows for a rebuilt table, and a left-out entry this build would not leave out. Readers and regression tests for the historical records the live stores hold are kept. CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md state the general conversion rule, and the migration, shipped, sqlite-store and snapshot docs match. Committed as dcd034a and pushed to origin/master with Greg's approval. Installed code-only as build df134a518b60 (same schema 81b4b805acfb): readiness passed on both live stores first, no process was stopped, and the previous binary is kept at ~/.engram/backups/engram-9029bfcbbd4c-20260923-122733.exe. Evidence: 8 review rounds ending clean, full gates on the final input, store-copy readiness/doctor/export-import (.git/review-runs/store-check-20260923-120808), and independent evaluation 19cf3815ced24d9d9f1ba40bd64fb8d6 (8/8 pass).
